measurement_contract.corpus: representative authored fixture concatenation, repeated and tokenizer-bounded to the recorded prefix
measurement_contract.isolation: new process per profile; one resident model/context; normal synchronization boundaries; no concurrent build or model job during timing
measurement_contract.summary_codec: pre-inference identity; observed_codec contains completed post-inference counters/path
measurement_contract.memory: native model+context+compute allocation snapshots sum host and device buffers; payload is separate; device peaks not measured
measurement_contract.pairing: same model, executable, source manifests, native patch hashes, prompt-text hashes within each matrix, and fixed batch/ubatch

placement_all_transform_ops.notes: Only GET_ROWS observed on CPU; all sign multiplication/matrix operations and required cache/attention operations were scheduled on Vulkan. Includes other model operations, not exclusively PQ3.

native_correctness.note: Cross-layout drift is characterization, not an acceptance bound; CPU attention uses its separate Q8-query oracle.

quality_gates.execution: workspace tests serialized because a parallel binding unit run encountered the existing global-logger callback count race; no assertions weakened

decision: Keep PQ3 opt-in and FP16/full defaults unchanged. Candidate fails retrieval/KL gates and repeats a near-full 4K slowdown versus Q4. Do not automatically proceed to QJL or claim production/vendor support.
limits: NVIDIA single-device evidence only; AMD and Intel not validated.
32K capacity exercised with 1024-token prefixes; near-full 32K quality/recovery not measured.
One resident context per benchmark process; simultaneous resident-context capacity not measured.
No measured device peak; native allocations do not establish a hard VRAM ceiling.
Scalar whole-model quality not characterized by the coopmat2 quality run.
Live kernels retain finite activation/representable norm preconditions; no per-write numeric error channel.
Synthetic attention matrix tests cover N=1/8/64 and KV=7/65/512; split-K is not isolated as a separate regression case.
Ordinary 128-head Llama is architecture-allowlisted but only LFM3 has model-backed evidence here.

cli_smoke.notes: Actual CLI flags, ordinary worker inference, diagnostics and normal process shutdown.
